A market order fills immediately at the best available price.
市价单会以当前最优价格立即成交。
Place a limit order if you only want to buy below a set price.
如果你只想在某个价位以下买入,就挂一张限价单。
A stop-loss order sells your shares once the price drops to a trigger.
止损单会在价格跌到触发价时自动卖出你的股票。
She set a take-profit at 250 to lock in the gain.
她在250设了一个止盈单来锁定收益。
Slippage happens when your order fills at a worse price than expected.
当你的订单以比预期更差的价格成交时,就产生了滑点。
A narrow spread usually means the stock is very liquid.
价差窄通常说明这只股票流动性很好。
High liquidity lets you enter and exit a position quickly.
流动性高让你能快速建仓和平仓。
Volatility measures how sharply a price swings up and down.
波动率衡量价格上下摆动的剧烈程度。
Fast execution matters most when the market is moving quickly.
市场剧烈波动时,快速成交最为关键。
A partial fill means only some of your shares were bought.
部分成交意味着你只买到了一部分股票。
Leverage magnifies both your gains and your losses.
杠杆会同时放大你的盈利和亏损。
Buying on margin means borrowing money from your broker.
用保证金买入意味着向你的券商借钱。
Short selling profits when the stock price falls.
做空在股价下跌时才能获利。
Investors hedge their positions to reduce downside risk.
投资者对冲持仓以降低下行风险。
The company pays a dividend to shareholders every quarter.
公司每个季度向股东派发一次股息。
You must own the stock before the ex-dividend date to get paid.
你必须在除息日之前持有股票才能拿到股息。
A dividend yield of 4% is attractive in a low-rate world.
在低利率环境下,4%的股息收益率很有吸引力。
You realize a capital gain only when you sell for a profit.
只有当你以盈利价格卖出时,才实现了资本利得。
Your cost basis is what you paid, used to work out taxes.
成本基础是你的买入价,用来计算税费。
Open a brokerage account before you can trade US stocks.
在交易美股之前,先开一个券商账户。
Many brokers now charge zero commission on US stock trades.
如今许多券商对美股交易收取零佣金。
US stocks now follow a T+1 settlement cycle.
美股现在采用T+1的交收周期。
A balanced portfolio spreads risk across many assets.
一个均衡的投资组合把风险分散到多种资产上。
Diversification is the closest thing to a free lunch in investing.
分散投资是投资中最接近免费午餐的东西。
Your asset allocation should match your risk tolerance.
你的资产配置应当与你的风险承受力相匹配。
Blue chip stocks are large, stable, and well-known companies.
蓝筹股指的是规模大、稳定又知名的公司。
An ETF lets you buy a whole index in a single trade.
一只ETF让你一笔交易就买入整个指数。
An index fund quietly tracks the market at very low cost.
指数基金以极低的成本静静地跟踪整个市场。
A mutual fund pools money from many investors.
共同基金把许多投资者的钱汇集在一起。
A bond pays fixed interest and returns your principal at maturity.
债券支付固定利息,并在到期时归还你的本金。
The stock jumped after earnings beat expectations.
财报超出预期后,这只股票大涨。
Weak guidance for next quarter dragged the shares lower.
下季度疲软的业绩指引拖累了股价下跌。
A bull market can last for years before it finally turns.
牛市可以持续数年,直到最终反转。
A bear market is usually defined as a 20% drop from the peak.
熊市通常被定义为从高点下跌20%。
A correction is a short, sharp drop of about 10%.
回调是指约10%的短促而急剧的下跌。
Stocks staged a strong rally after the rate cut.
降息之后,股市展开了一轮强劲反弹。
Every listed company trades under a short ticker symbol.
每家上市公司都以一个简短的股票代码进行交易。
Read the prospectus carefully before you invest in an IPO.
在投资一只新股之前,请仔细阅读招股说明书。
Most funds are measured against a benchmark like the S&P 500.
大多数基金都以标普500这样的基准指数来衡量。
Compound interest quietly turns small savings into large sums.
复利会悄悄地把小额储蓄变成一大笔钱。
Younger investors often have a higher risk tolerance.
更年轻的投资者往往有更高的风险承受力。
Add a stock to your watchlist to track it without buying.
把一只股票加入自选股列表,不买也能跟踪它。
